stories.headline: Rope bridges gave Amazon animals 15,000 safe road crossings
stories.summary: Eight canopy bridges strung over a road near Alta Floresta let spider monkeys, marmosets and capuchins cross 15,000 times in 15 months, with not a single roadkill recorded.
stories.why: A simple rope bridge keeps rare primates alive and their forest connected.

stories.headline: A Roman temple to Mars turned up just under a forest floor
stories.summary: Beside the Kapersburg fort, archaeologists found a small temple with an inscription to Mars and a winged statuette of Victory.
stories.why: Storms and drought cleared the trees and revealed a frontier town's sacred spot.

stories.headline: A smarter battery design could last 20% longer
stories.summary: Chalmers researchers modelled an EV battery pack that bypasses worn-out cells. In one typical case it delayed a battery swap by about 14 months.
stories.why: Longer-lived batteries mean cheaper EVs and less waste.

stories.stat_label: changing water clouds seen beyond us
stories.headline: Webb watched water clouds change on a world 7.5 light-years away
stories.summary: Webb tracked WISE 0855, the coldest known brown dwarf, for 11 hours. Its water clouds grew thicker and thinner: the first such weather confirmed beyond our solar system.
stories.why: It's like reading the weather report of another world.

fun_fact: WISE 0855 is about 265 K, colder than Earth's average surface temperature.
